name: Machine (type not recorded)
description: Neutral names used when the machine type is unknown. Record machine_class in the machine context to use a specific profile.

CHK-ONSITE-ACTUATOR.question: Inspect the actuator and its mechanism on site
tools: Service tooling approved by the OEM

points.label: Operator input
points.if_missing: The operator's own inputs are not recorded: whether a person commanded the change cannot be read.

points.label: Command link
points.if_missing: The link between operator and machine is not measured: delays or losses on it cannot be read.

points.label: Controller (mode, setpoints, configuration)
points.if_missing: The controller's own mode, configuration and messages are not recorded.

points.label: Output commands the controller sends
points.if_missing: The controller's output commands are not recorded.

points.label: Actuator actually moving
points.if_missing: No actuator feedback is recorded: whether an actuator did what it was commanded cannot be read.

points.label: Machine motion
points.if_missing: The machine's motion is not measured.

mechanisms.label: Operator command
mechanisms.needs: The operator's inputs and the console log at the onset

mechanisms.label: Command link delay or loss
mechanisms.needs: Link quality and command timing records for the window

mechanisms.label: Controller behaviour (mode change, configuration, failsafe or control logic)
mechanisms.needs: The controller's own mode, event and configuration log at the onset

mechanisms.label: Output path (driver, wiring or actuator electronics): command not carried out
mechanisms.needs: Actuator feedback, or an inspection of the actuator and its wiring

mechanisms.label: Mechanics, load or environment: actuator moves but the machine does not respond as expected
mechanisms.needs: Actuator feedback alongside the motion, or an inspection of the mechanism

mechanisms.label: Measurement error: the machine moved normally but a sensor reported otherwise
mechanisms.needs: A second, independent measurement of the same motion
